records.subject: Still want to get Quartz Collective set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Quartz Collective set up
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Glad to have Quartz Collective on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, reached first_project on day 1 (quick start, engaged admin), but no invite sent and no key milestone with 8 days left. Only comms is our own onboarding note [email:106c3f89] with no customer reply, so no active signal of momentum. Pro plan suggests intent; modest unaided odds.

draft.subject: A quick next step for Quartz Collective
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Nice work getting your first project up last week — projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so that's the right foundation.

The usual next step is bringing one teammate in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather add a few at once.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through what your team should tackle first.

Best,
Priya
